As you read your reading suggestions will update to match how much reading you do. If you read extra one day, your overall goal will update to match. If you miss a couple of days, your daily suggestions will add some verses to make sure that you still reach your goal.

Simple, no clutter layouts make it easy to keep up with your goal. Whether you're trying to finish by the end of the year, or a baptism, or any other special occasion, there's nothing between you and your scriptures.
